transition.source: verified ONNX FP32 Transition A artifact
transition.purpose: evidence-bounded quantization continuity decision, not universal equivalence certification

decision_states.scientific_fail_rule: FAIL requires complete, valid, replayable ONNX FP32 and ONNX INT8 evidence demonstrating a frozen operational-tolerance violation.

onnx_fp32_measurement_null.required_source: verified Transition A ONNX FP32 artifact

calibration.canonical_order: query ID ascending by UTF-8 bytes

data_roles.measurement_null: ONNX FP32 source resolution only; never calibration or promotion evidence
data_roles.quantization_calibration: the only role allowed to calibrate Transition B static INT8
data_roles.contract_development: diagnostic only; cannot tune a frozen candidate after target evidence exists
data_roles.validation: pre-promotion evaluation after the contract and INT8 configuration are frozen
data_roles.frozen_critical: blocking regression role with zero tolerance for declared quality and ranking regressions
data_roles.final_holdout: single final decision role; excluded from calibration, threshold selection, and iterative target changes

tolerance_inheritance.rule: Transition B inherits the frozen functional and topology materiality limits from Transition A. The ONNX FP32 measurement null supplies detection limits only and cannot directly select operational tolerances.

decision_policy.PASS: All required replayable evidence is present, the static calibration identity is valid, and every inherited applicable operational tolerance is satisfied.
decision_policy.FAIL: Valid replayable evidence shows one or more inherited applicable operational tolerances exceeded.
decision_policy.INCONCLUSIVE: Evidence is complete but uncertainty or an interval intersects an inherited operational boundary without a justified PASS or FAIL.
decision_policy.BLOCKED: A declared artifact, observation, calibration identity, prerequisite, or replay requirement is missing or fails integrity verification.
decision_policy.EXECUTION_ERROR: Quantization, ONNX runtime, provider, preprocessing, or output execution fails. This is not a scientific regression.

replay_policy.artifact_integrity: SHA-256 tamper-evident manifests; artifacts are not claimed physically immutable

implementation_boundaries.calibration_data: validates the calibration split identity and produces only canonical calibration batches
implementation_boundaries.quantization: creates the INT8 artifact from a validated ONNX FP32 artifact and calibration reader
implementation_boundaries.onnx_observation: runs one frozen ONNX artifact and captures canonical observations
implementation_boundaries.comparison: performs pure source-target metric and topology comparison
implementation_boundaries.decision: applies this contract to a complete comparison report
implementation_boundaries.replay: reconstructs comparison and decision from recorded artifacts without model execution
implementation_boundaries.orchestration: thin dispatch only; it must not duplicate the responsibilities above

non_scope: INT8 candidate generation before ONNX FP32 measurement null
